newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BZW appoints new NZ investment banking MD.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints new NZ investment banking MD.

text.p: Stock broker and investment banker BZW on Monday announced it had appointed Michael Walls managing director of investment banking, New Zealand, effective January 1, 1997.
Walls joins BZW from law firm Chapman Tripp Sheffield Young.
BZW said Walls was one of New Zealand's most experienced and senior corporate lawyers and his appointment would capitalise on his broad experience in corporate law and public affairs.

Walls is a former chairman of NZ Steel and is chairman of both Independent Press Communications and the European/New Zealand Press Council. He is a trustee of the New Zealand Institute of Economic Research and was a member of the expert advisory committee on Company Law Reform.
BZW said it anticipated further rapid growth of its investment banking division.
